images.author: Christopher L. Riley
images.caption: Front view of four commercial buildings in Celina, Ohio. The buildings are contributing parts of the National Register-listed Main Street Commercial Historic District.

facade.notes: one of four contiguous fronts on Main Street, Celina OH (historic district); left to right: white Italianate, lavender Italianate, green Queen Anne, Romanesque bank; all share zero setback, a storefront band at the same height, 2-3 storeys and party walls -- different styles held together by height, rhythm and setback; this one: a pressed-metal front with a central two-storey oriel bay and a heavy bracketed cornice; the storefront below was rebuilt in modern glass and the transom covered

why.note: the street wall: every front on the line, so the styles can differ
mail-order pressed-metal fronts (Mesker Brothers etc.) let small towns buy city ornament
Longstreth: public shop below, offices or flats above
